bio: Works on wavefront sensors, adaptive-optics control and laboratory validation, including the Ingot WFS and MATTO.
long_bio: Simone studies wavefront-sensing techniques for large telescopes, particularly the Ingot sensor for elongated sodium laser guide stars. His work includes optical design, automated prism alignment, laboratory tests and sensitivity to introduced low-order aberrations. These results support the evaluation of alternatives to conventional wavefront sensing on extremely large telescopes.
